hints.title: Partitioning Across Arrays
hints.text: Partition the two sorted lists such that the left half and right half contain equal elements and all left elements are less than or equal to right elements.

hints.title: Binary Partition Cut on Shorter Array
hints.text: Apply search on the smaller array partition index. The partition of the larger array is then uniquely determined by the half length requirement.

hints.title: Boundary Value Cross Comparison
hints.text: Ensure max of left elements from both arrays is less than or equal to min of right elements from both arrays. If left of first array is too large, shift partition left; otherwise shift right. When balanced, compute median from the boundary extrema.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal logarithmic partition search on shorter array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Merging arrays takes O(M + N) which fails the logarithmic time requirement.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual partition boundaries compute median without storing merged sequences.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Cut the smaller array using binary search and verify cross boundary elements.
